name: Day to Day Rollercoaster
source:
You are living in ultimate chaos and are determined to take control of your life once and for all! You will be given daily tasks for each room that will allow you to gain or lose points. Make sure that your mental health is high!

Because that's what determines if you truly have a balanced life! Talk to friends, go to work, bake, and rest. It's up to you!

[Edited from [url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/game-jam]Itch.io[/url]]
